critical_code_review_comments: Stale process root cause: supervisor's frontend program used to point to /app/OfficeflowV3/frontend and the orphaned node process kept holding port 3000 across supervisor restarts. Recommend adding a preStart hook in supervisor config (e.g., 'fuser -k 3000/tcp || true') so a leftover process cannot block the new binding again.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL https://officeflow-v3.preview.emergentagent.com/ is healthy. Frontend served from /app/frontend, backend from /app/backend. Only lingering issue is a failing WS connection to /api/ws/dispatch (non-blocking).
rca of the issue: Stale craco/node PID 3407 from removed /app/OfficeflowV3/frontend was still bound to port 3000. The new /app/frontend craco kept printing 'Something is already running on port 3000' and never bound. Fix (already applied by main agent): killed the stale process, restarted supervisor's frontend program - new craco (PID 21524) now correctly binds port 3000 from /app/frontend. Verified end-to-end via preview URL.
